in_hebrew.name: ג'אניוה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ג'אניוה נגזר מהמילים העבריות 'אלוהים הוא חנן' ו-'אלוהים רחם', ומשמעותו 'אלוהים מרחם על עם ישראל' או 'חנינת האל'. השם קשור לנושא הרחמים והחסד האלוהיים.

in_greek.name: Τζάνεβα
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Τζάνεβα προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὶς ἑβραϊκὲς λέξεις 'Θεὸς ἔλεησεν' καὶ σημαίνει 'ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ' ἤ 'ὁ ἐλεήμων Θεός'. Σχετίζεται μὲ τὴν ἔννοια τῆς θείας εὐσπλαχνίας καὶ ἔλεος.

in_latin.name: Janeva
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Janeva derivatur ex vocibus hebraicis 'Deus misertus est' et significat 'gratia Dei' vel 'misericordia Dei'. Coniungitur cum notione misericordiae et gratiae divinae.

in_english.long_meaning: The name Janeva originates from Hebrew roots, specifically from the words 'Yahweh chanan' and 'El rachem', meaning 'God is gracious' or 'God is merciful'. It is associated with the concept of divine mercy and grace. Historically, the name reflects the Judeo-Christian tradition of expressing gratitude for God's benevolence. In Christian contexts, Janeva symbolizes a personality characterized by compassion, empathy, and kindness. The name has been adopted across various Christian cultures, signifying a connection to biblical values of mercy and grace.

data.cultural_impact: The name Janeva, while rooted in Greek origins, has been adopted and transformed by various cultures around the world. In some Slavic countries, it is a popular female name. Despite its foreign origins, it carries a rich cultural history and can serve as a constant reminder of the strong connection between Christianity and the diverse communities it has touched.
data.spiritual_significance: Like all Christian names, Janeva holds profound spiritual significance. The name embodies the grace and mercy of God, exemplified in John the Baptist, who acknowledged the greatness of Christ and prepared the way for His ministry to begin. Janeva serves as a testament to the message of love, forgiveness, and salvation present in the Christian faith. The name invites its holder to live a life guided by these principles and to continuously seek grace and favor from God.
